upstream_revision_note: The provider publishes no public source revision for this page. This snapshot is the frozen evidence.

transports.wss: documented, conditional access for 48 SoulPoint members

parameters.name: maxBlockNumber
parameters.meaning: last block for which the bundle is valid; default is current block plus 100

parameters.name: maxTimestamp
parameters.meaning: latest unix time in seconds for which the bundle is valid

parameters.name: revertingTxHashes
parameters.meaning: transactions that are allowed to revert

parameters.name: noMerge
parameters.meaning: default false, which allows the bundle to be merged with others

parameters.name: positionFirst
parameters.meaning: default false; when set, position is strictly by priority fee; when unset, a late bundle may be appended at the block tail

response.success: result is the bundle hash as a string
response.failure: JSON-RPC error object with code and message; the documented example uses code -38000

ranking: gas fees of bundle transactions that are not in the public pool, reduced by ten percent, plus BNB sent to the builder control account
fee_floor: no explicit numeric minimum is stated on these pages
downstream: not stated, except that a chain reorganisation makes included transactions public
pre_submission: not stated: the reference documents a list of signed raw transactions; it does not describe a bundle whose first transaction is the submitter's own launch that has not been broadcast

faq_statements.statement: for a bundle the average gas price, not that of a single representative transaction, is checked; a transaction at zero gas price is possible when other transactions of the bundle pay enough
after a chain reorganisation a bundle may land only partly or not through a partner validator; the transactions of the invalidated block become public
only the first transaction of a bundle, its sender, is checked; several bundles whose first transaction has the same sender are treated as a replacement attempt that needs a higher gas price

ordering_and_atomicity: not stated on these pages as a guarantee
